task_objective: Re-derive stored BLOCK verdicts from current blockable rule IDs at both catalog trust points, surface policy disagreements, and publish effective classifications without enabling enforcement.

setup.plan_state: The plan was already committed as the tip of dev and therefore became the implementation branch point; no duplicate empty plan commit was created.
setup.remote_dev_pull: Attempted git pull --ff-only origin dev; origin has no dev ref. The clean local dev commit ebd4699 was used as the required base.
setup.pre_change_danger: Against the committed 42-release store, the configured-release gate treated all eight stored BLOCK records as effective BLOCK. Under a forced in-memory enforce posture, those eight releases would be excluded. The TDD generator fixture reproduced their removal from both catalogs.

policy_decisions.demotion_only: Only stored BLOCK records are re-derived. MANUAL_REVIEW with a currently blockable MALWARE rule remains MANUAL_REVIEW, so stale data can never be promoted into an exclusion.
policy_decisions.at_least_one_rule: A stored BLOCK remains effective BLOCK when at least one recorded blocking_rule_id is in the current blockable_rules, even if other recorded IDs are no longer blockable.
policy_decisions.underivable_block: A stored BLOCK with empty or missing blocking_rule_ids is re-derived as MANUAL_REVIEW and logged. This intentionally fails open because the current auditor cannot justify excluding that release.
policy_decisions.stored_state: VerdictResult.audit_classification remains the stored value. Public audit records use classification for the effective value and stored_classification for the durable value, making policy disagreement explicit without rewriting security-verdicts.json.
policy_decisions.test_expectation_changes: Legacy catalog-gate fixtures used STATIC_EVAL while asserting a genuinely blocked release. They now use ARCHIVE_TRAVERSAL and supply blockable_rules because the plan explicitly makes non-structural stored BLOCK verdicts non-blocking; the exclusion expectations themselves were preserved.

implementation: effective_stored_classification centralizes demotion-only policy re-derivation and is used by configured-release classification and upstream-catalog matching.
Catalog generation and update checks load blockable_rules once, pass them through both trust points, and fail open if policy loading fails.
Configured and upstream demotions log the plugin or repository, release, stored rule IDs, and current non-blockable status without logging evidence.
Generated audit JSON and HTML show effective classification, preserve stored classification, and explain when a verdict predates current policy.

verification_evidence.tdd_red: 15 focused tests failed before implementation. After correcting the tracked-store fixture to read security-verdicts.json rather than the legacy cache, the failures reproduced both trust-point defects, catalog removal, empty-rationale blocking, and the old audit schema.
verification_evidence.focused_green: 18 focused verdict-rederivation tests passed in 0.04s; the combined gate, audit-publication, verdict, and generator selection passed 65 tests and 14 subtests in 0.13s.
verification_evidence.ordered_verification: Failure and underivable cases ran before the all-eight negative control; 10 selected tests passed in 0.03s.
verification_evidence.catalog_negative_control: A deterministic generator run against all eight BLOCK entries from the committed store retained eight plugin releases in both stable and testing catalogs under an in-memory enforce policy, and emitted eight policy-demotion log lines.
verification_evidence.structural_control: A stored BLOCK with ARCHIVE_TRAVERSAL remained BLOCK; a mixed stale-plus-ARCHIVE_TRAVERSAL rationale also remained BLOCK.
verification_evidence.promotion_control: A stored MANUAL_REVIEW with MALWARE remained MANUAL_REVIEW.
verification_evidence.underivable_control: Stored BLOCK entries with empty and missing blocking_rule_ids both became MANUAL_REVIEW; generator output stated that no blocking rule IDs were recorded.
verification_evidence.upstream_control: The upstream-catalog path demoted SHELL_CURL_PIPE, retained ARCHIVE_TRAVERSAL as blocking, and logged repository, release, and rule ID without fixture evidence.
verification_evidence.audit_publication: The rendered audit output showed MANUAL_REVIEW as effective and BLOCK as stored for a stale verdict, retained BLOCK/BLOCK for a structural control, and preserved the existing evidence/file-content exclusion tests.
verification_evidence.classification_mutation: Replacing configured-release re-derivation with the stored classification made the stale control fail while the structural control passed: 1 failed, 1 passed.
verification_evidence.upstream_mutation: Replacing upstream re-derivation with the stored classification made the stale control fail while the structural control passed: 1 failed, 1 passed.
verification_evidence.quality_gates: ruff check passed; ruff format reported 44 files formatted; pytest reported 300 passed and 21 subtests passed in 1.11s; no review notes were deleted; quality gates passed.

review_round_01.duplicate_identity_red: With two same-identity entries, the non-blocking entry first produced False for both MANUAL_REVIEW and stale BLOCK variants; 2 failed and the reverse-order controls passed.
review_round_01.resolution: The upstream gate now evaluates every identity match until a genuinely blockable verdict is found and defers stale-BLOCK demotion logs until the final answer is non-blocking. The committed-store test asserts stored-versus-effective policy invariants over every record without fixed corpus counts, and the generator derives its demotion count from a self-sufficient fixture.
review_round_01.targeted_green: The verdict-rederivation test module passed 22 tests in 0.05s.
review_round_01.quality_gates: ruff check passed; ruff format reported 45 files already formatted; pytest reported 304 passed and 21 subtests passed in 1.16s; no review notes were deleted; quality gates passed.

explicitly_not_verified: This change does not enable enforcement and does not claim enforcement is safe to enable.
The stored verdict file was not migrated or rewritten; stale classifications remain until a later audit.
BLOCK remains unexercised on the committed corpus, so this change provides no true-positive or false-positive measurement for structural blocking.
The upstream Decky catalog plugins that are not in the local verdict store remain unaudited.
